breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still contains both 'Use a gamma-centered Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid' AND 'The k-point grid must have a half shift.' This repeats the exact inconsistency from the incomplete prompt — specifying a gamma-centered grid (which implies no shift) while simultaneously requiring a half shift. The ground truth resolves this by simply stating to use a gamma-centered k-point grid and omitting any mention of a half shift. The agent failed to remove the contradictory half-shift instruction.
